reviews.text: Excellent experience. It was my first time bringing my dog ​​to the vet and I found the staff to be kind and knowledgeable. Dr. Trio gave my dog ​​a thorough examination and explained everything very clearly.
I brought my little dog who had swelling in his eye and with care and patience they took the best care of him.

Many thanks to the Oftavet eye center. This morning, after a month of treatment for my kitten, we had decided to operate on her eye. Many thanks to the doctor, the operation was avoided. The kitten is doing much better thanks to the treatments recommended by the center. I'm very happy that we avoided the operation. Many thanks to you as always. A big hug 🙏🙏🙏 infinitely thank you.

I had a terrible experience with this center and with Dr. Trio. My dog ​​had a genetic cataract, and I took him to her. Being a 5-year-old Beagle/Jack Russell mix, he's particularly hyperactive, although sociable and playful. The doctor immediately showed us very little empathy and compassion and told us she couldn't operate on him due to his difficult temperament, leaving us not even a glimmer of hope. She didn't give us any advice on how to get him used to the eye drops, but with her ruling, she condemned my dog ​​to blindness. We then turned to another veterinary center in Naples. Thanks to the other ophthalmologist's advice, my dog ​​adjusted to the eye drops, underwent the surgery, and is now doing very well. As far as I'm concerned, I absolutely do not recommend this veterinary eye center.
Dr. Trio made the wrong diagnosis, that day the machines jammed and we didn't like her way of doing things.

Absolutely rude. We were there for cataract surgery on my dog, but the lady at the door was probably nervous herself and almost attacked us for every question we asked. They may be good but they are rude to the max.

I first discovered the OftaVet clinic on a Thursday about a month ago, on the recommendation of my trusted veterinarian, because my "furry girl," Camilla, a female Australian Shepherd, was blind.
I'll leave aside the background: after a long walk the previous Sunday, my dog ​​was staggering and urinating blood, and I was forced to take her urgently to a well-known veterinary emergency room in Naples, where nothing was fixed, but at a considerable cost. When I realized my Camilla was blind and banging all over the place, my veterinarian, after examining her, suggested I urgently go to OftaVet.
There, Dr. Stefania Trio diagnosed my Camilla with glaucoma in both eyes. Despite the "severe" diagnosis, I found empathy and professionalism from the entire staff, and the equipment used for the eyes closely resembles that used in a human ophthalmology practice.
Dr. Trio, along with her colleagues, immediately intervened to lower the intraocular pressure, and I remember well that her procedure lasted about three hours.
The team of other veterinary doctors also cared lovingly for Camilla. In fact, even when administering the mannitol drip, I saw great care even in trimming the fur on her paw to allow for the insertion of an IV for the mannitol drip.
Dr. Trio then prescribed a treatment consisting of four eye drops to be administered three times a day, and while she didn't give me any certainty, she tried to reassure me that the treatment could at least partially save my dog's sight.
The first few days of treatment weren't easy. My Camilla kept bumping all over the place, and the effects of the mannitol meant she urinated constantly and everywhere. But at the end of the first week, a "first miracle" occurred. In fact, when I went to the clinic for my checkup, I noticed that my Camilla had not only identified the door of the "OftaVet" veterinary practice, but was looking at me, almost making me understand that I should quickly ring the bell to come in.
I could see that Dr. Trio treated me with love because my Camilla went directly to her and began to "welcome" her.
After a week of treatment, my Camilla had regained the ability to see in her right eye.
After the first checkup, the doctor invited me to return in three weeks and continue the eye drops. I insisted on returning after two weeks, and with great joy, I witnessed the "second miracle"—that is, I was diagnosed with Camilla's regained sight in both eyes.
Today, as I write this review, we are going to our third checkup.
I am infinitely grateful to Dr. Trio and her staff for caring for Camilla and for doing everything they could to ensure her sight returned. I should add that the fee for the first visit was fair and not at all excessive, especially considering the time spent caring for my dog. Furthermore, during the two follow-up visits, despite my insistence, Dr. Trio refused to charge me anything.
I can say that I have found a veterinary practice specializing in ophthalmology where professionalism and honesty are at the highest levels, and I will always thank Dr. Trio and her staff for what they did for my Camilla.
My only regret is that the clinic specializes only in "eyes," because I would have loved Dr. Trio to be my go-to veterinarian for all my Camilla's treatments. Gennaro De Luca, Camilla's "dad"!

We were in Naples on vacation, and right around Ferragosto, our dog had an eye emergency. Despite it being a holiday, the ophthalmologist opened his clinic just for us, greeted us with great professionalism and kindness, performed a thorough examination, gave us medication samples, and—incredibly—even offered to drive us back to our accommodations, since we had no transportation.

Another positive note was the very fair price, despite it being a holiday. Such rare kindness and helpfulness. Thank you so much!

We came here for a follow-up appointment after our dog suffered an eye injury. We arranged the appointment via WhatsApp. Everything was great! Parking was available nearby in a garage – we were informed about it via WhatsApp and it worked perfectly. Many thanks to the entire team for the quick and competent help! ☺️

I went to Dr. Trio for glaucoma in my dog. She was extremely helpful and patient with me and my dog, Greta. Her staff is incredibly kind, helpful, and welcoming. Both the doctor and her staff assist you throughout the entire procedure with any questions or concerns you may have. I recommend her to anyone who needs her help. A true professional. Thank you so much for everything.

Dr. Trio and her staff are synonymous with expertise, professionalism, helpfulness, and love for animals. After four months of unsuccessful pharmacological attempts, Dr. Trio and her staff performed surgery on my 9-year-old Jack Russell, who is now healthy, lively, and carefree as ever. Thank you again!

Four months after the operation on our little Pomeranian Jack, I wanted to congratulate the super Doctor Trio and all the staff who have restored the sight in his little eye. Our super Doctor has magical velvet hands. A huge hug and thank you so much again for your availability and for all the love you put in.
Unfortunately, it was a terrible experience.

A very well-organized veterinary medical center specializing in ophthalmology. When I contacted Dr. Stefania Trio by phone, she immediately agreed to examine my dog ​​Gioia's right eye on August 17th at 3:00 PM. The visit was conducted with great professionalism and expertise. Dr. Trio is very empathetic with her little four-legged patients 🐶 and is extremely kind to their human owners 😀.

On August 15th, my dog ​​was attacked and hit in the eye. I called Dr. Trio, and she was immediately available to address my concerns. She opened the clinic for my Lucy's treatment. ♥️ I found her to be extremely professional and have a big heart. An exceptionally empathetic person. Dr. Trio, my gratitude to you is immense. Thank you ❤️
A top-quality eye care center. Dr. Trio was very professional and kind, as was her entire staff. The center is beautiful and equipped with high-quality equipment.

Good evening... I didn't know this clinical reality or the doctor. I chose instinctively and I had a FANTASTIC HUMAN AND PROFESSIONAL experience... emergency care, competence, honesty and professionalism... and so much humanity towards me who was very worried. Given the diagnosis, fast climate, sharing of the care with consent formatted in detail and also probable prognosis... Operation, cared for and controlled with efficiency and effectiveness... I have no words to thank Doctor Reality in the uncommon territory... honesty and not venal... well... moved to have had such a beautiful experience I recommend this wonderful specialist of the highest level to everyone... Thank youuuu from Taker and his grandmother

Some time ago, I had one of my cats operated on. The operation was a success, except that "Doctor" Trio, a venal woman like no other, hadn't gotten the eye drops (not available at the pharmacy), without which the healing wouldn't have occurred. And she only said so after charging me handsomely. I should have smashed her face in.
Moral of the story: my poor cat, blind forever due to a dark membrane over her eyes, only saw for three days, then went back to the dark, after suffering so much and needlessly post-op.
Stay away from this "lady."

Dr. Guerrilla had a terrible experience and was only interested in money.
Scoundrels.
